comparison_with_expert.key_finding: Claude Opus and domain expert show remarkably similar error detection patterns — both fail on 'subtle' errors (BC swap, wrong viscosity) and succeed on 'severe' errors (gravity flip, wrong turb model, BC swap in S5). This suggests VLM physics reasoning follows similar heuristics as human visual inspection.
